title: Mega Man X4 · Zero
subtitle: PlayStation / Saturn · Zero campaign
intro: Zero’s own boss route, all 12 permanent pickups and the optional Black Zero start. No Dr. Light armor capsules appear in this campaign.

stages.name: Web Spider
stages.tip: On this first visit, jump-slash with the saber when he descends, then dash away from his tracking web. Shippuuga is a later damage option, not a reliable stun loop.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: In Area 2, burn the brown tree trunks along the main path with your fire attack. The heart is inside the second burnable trunk.

stages.tip: Take the Ride Armor through the lower lava tunnel into the arena and punch until it breaks. Then use saber combos or Raijingeki between his fire attacks.

stages.name: Frost Walrus
stages.tip: Use Ryuenjin beside him, then retreat before he slides. Repeat after he recovers; do not stay underneath falling ice.

items.name: EX Tank
items.text: In Area 1’s slippery slope section, look for the high upper-right ledge above the spikes. Double-jump from the nearby platform to reach it.

stages.tip: Double-jump above him and use Hyouretsuzan to strike downward. Avoid landing in the water; wait for him to return within safe reach.

items.text: In Area 1, do not jump at the third gap. Drop onto the lower platform holding the heart, then jump out before the next gap.

stages.name: Cyber Peacock
stages.tip: Dash until he reappears, then use Ryuenjin underneath him. Move away before his targeting cursors settle on you.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: In Area 1, finish timed room 2 quickly enough for S rank. The reward teleporter leads to the heart. Use Kuuenzan to destroy yellow orbs. An A rank advances without the reward; replay if needed.

items.text: Earn S rank in timed room 3 of Area 1. Enter the reward chamber and collect the tank before continuing. Zero’s first room rewards only an extra life.

stages.tip: Use Rakuhouha when Owl is vulnerable and nearby. After its energy runs out, jump-slash between his attacks. Keep away from his grab.

items.text: In Area 1, reach the platform beneath the giant laser cannon before it is destroyed. Dash over to grab the heart; use Eagle’s hover to escape. If the platform falls, retry the stage.

extraSections:
Useful tips

Refills and preparation

Restock · Frost Walrus

Return to Snow Base after clearing it. At the start of Area 1, climb the walls to the upper path. Use Kuuenbu (Split Mushroom): double-jump to reach the high route. Follow it right for health capsules, weapon energy and an extra life.

Collect the capsules, use Pause → Exit, and re-enter to repeat until your tanks are stocked. Pick up health even when your life bar is full. Check the tank gauges before leaving; one pass need not fill everything.

Save weapon energy for Rakuhouha

Zero’s normal saber attacks and other learned techniques do not spend weapon energy. Rakuhouha does: refill its gauge with weapon capsules, and keep the Weapon Tank stocked for Storm Owl and the fortress.

Clear Cyber Peacock’s yellow spheres

After Split Mushroom, jump and use the spinning air slash (Kuuenzan) to destroy the yellow spheres in the timed rooms. This helps preserve the time needed for S-rank rewards.

Black Zero start

Black Zero is a cosmetic alternate palette in original console X4. It does not require parts or a special ending.

Enter at character select, before starting. These are the original North American PlayStation inputs. Port, region and controller mappings can differ; the original Windows port uses different codes.

  1. Highlight Zero. Hold R1 and press Right six times.
  2. Release R1. Hold Circle, then press Start to choose Zero. Keep Circle held until gameplay begins. Confirm the black palette before continuing.

Original Saturn: hold R, press Right six times, release R, then hold B and press Start. Original 1997 Windows release: hold Up while selecting Zero. These Windows instructions are not the Steam Legacy Collection keyboard mapping.

Legacy Collection with an Xbox-layout controller, English game: Hold RB and press Right six times; release RB, then hold B while confirming Zero. Keep the held buttons down into gameplay and verify the changed color. For the Japanese Rockman version the face-button input differs; use its version-specific reference. The regular pickup route works without a code.

⤢

Colonel & Final Weapon

The midpoint Colonel encounter is a scene for Zero; the Spaceport battle after eight bosses is still required. Finish returns and refill tanks before the final stages.

  1. Colonel: jump the saber waves and attack after his teleport. Use short saber combos and back away.
  2. Iris: damage the armor until the floating crystal emerges, then attack that crystal. Avoid the horizontal laser lanes; striking only the armor does not finish the battle.
  3. General: climb by riding his fists, then hit the head from the side. Use jumping saber attacks. Avoid dropping between the moving hands.
  4. Final Weapon rematches: reuse the eight stage weaknesses. Sigma’s cloaked first form requires Ryuenjin; strike him from below when he appears low enough.
  5. Reaper Sigma: dodge the thrown scythe and attack his exposed head. Use jumping saber attacks; save a tank for the last battle. In the final multi-body fight, damage the exposed heads when they open, using the saber; avoid wasting attacks on closed armor.

basicsHtml:
Controls, tanks & returning to stages

Directions use actions rather than controller buttons: Jump, Dash, Fire and Special. Check your control mapping. Heart Tanks increase maximum health; Sub Tanks hold reserve health and are refilled by collecting health capsules. Exit from the pause menu works in cleared stages.

Zero’s technique inputs

  • Raijingeki: Special while standing.
  • Ryuenjin: Up + Special on the ground.
  • Hyouretsuzan: Down + Special in the air.
  • Kuuenbu: Jump again in midair. Kuuenzan: Attack in the air.
  • Hienkyaku: Dash after a normal jump.
  • Rakuhouha: Giga Attack; this consumes weapon energy.
  • Shippuuga: Special while dashing. Tenkuuha is passive.

Restock at Frost Walrus before the fortress →

startHereHtml:
First time playing X4?

What to know before the route

Zero fights with the Z-Saber and learns techniques from bosses. There are no armor capsules to collect in his X4 campaign. This page uses Zero’s own route and pickup methods.

He can ground-dash and wall-jump from the start. Split Mushroom adds a second jump and an aerial spinning slash; Jet Stingray adds an air dash. These abilities also open routes to pickups.

Techniques
Read the input list before a fight. Some techniques are attacks, while others change movement or the ordinary saber.
Health and tanks
Collect all eight hearts and refill the two health tanks before the fortress.
Weapon Tank
Restores energy for the limited-use Giga Attack. Most techniques do not consume energy.
Black Zero
A cosmetic alternate start in original X4. It is not an armor hunt and does not grant the later games’ stat improvements.

Choosing Zero changes the story and several late fights. X’s armor and charged-weapon pickup methods do not apply to this campaign.
